name: failure-is-read-from-the-process-not-the-launcher
breaks: the diagnosis goes back to whichever source is non-empty, which hands it to the launcher shell, because the shell speaks exactly when the real work never started and the process therefore has nothing to say. That is #650: a moved checkout produced one line of shell output, matched the missing-file rule, and told Dan to check that his photos were still in their original locations while the real traceback sat unread in the run's own log (L158)
